description: RTC source CV2102-S003 returned an actual HTTP 403 to one ordinary exact-URL request after a fresh stable receipt and manual review. Its body was not read; retrieval stopped.
required_followup: Preserve the denial and do not retry or seek a copy. Any future review must use other legitimately accessible evidence and must keep this source’s body unknown.

description: RTC CV2102-S003 and A Nação CV2102-S002 have a plausible date, location, ministry and planned-action match, but no written origin or story link is documented. The relationship and whether S003 describes the same or a distinct action remain unresolved.
required_followup: Do not combine the records or infer a separate episode from matching metadata alone. Seek independently accessible publication or archival linkage only if available without retrying the denied RTC URL.

description: The reviewed A Nação passage says the MAA strike was suspended before starting, but does not report a gathering. No evidence establishes a separate public assembly, attendance, or a physical endpoint for an action in Santo Antão.
required_followup: Keep no February event candidate unless evidence of an actually held public gathering and its threshold becomes available; do not treat workforce size or strike notice as turnout.

description: RTC CV2102-S005 reports a union threat to demonstrate outside Praia City Hall amid water-agency salary delays and concerns about sanitation dismissals, plus a separate Tourism Institute labor grievance. No demonstration date or execution is established.
required_followup: If this lead is revisited, obtain a new stable exact-URL receipt and complete manual publisher/origin review before any body request; verify whether a dated public action occurred and whether its threshold and government target are supported.

description: The INE strike notice for 3 February is reported suspended in the September 2021 A Nação retrospective. The 29 January demonstration is outside February; no physical February action or continuous episode is documented.
required_followup: Keep the January demonstration in its own month. Seek contemporaneous records only if needed to determine whether any separate February action occurred; do not infer continuity from the same organization.

description: Boundary checks surfaced the January 29 INE demonstration and February 3 strike notice, March 6 labor demonstration, March 18 IEFP strike and an April 8 MAA strike. The search found no documented physical action continuing across the February boundaries.
required_followup: Coordinate only through evidence-backed cross-month review; keep the listed outside-month actions in their date-owning units.

description: Fifteen searches used English, Portuguese, and one Kriolu spelling query. The search terms named Praia/Santiago, Mindelo/São Vicente, Santo Antão, Sal, Boa Vista, Fogo and São Nicolau, but online source coverage is uneven and there was no native-language review or targeted search for every municipality/island.
required_followup: Use fluent local review and regional sources/archives where available. Absence of search results is not evidence that no action occurred.

description: This is an open-web first pass, not a systematic review of LexisNexis, complete local newspaper archives, union bulletins or government records. Search result totals were not provided by the tool; the captured headers are not a completeness measure.
required_followup: If higher coverage is needed, use accessible archive collections and record their actual scope. Do not convert this pass into an exhaustive absence claim.

description: This worker dossier has no official Mass Mobilization ID or final eligibility decision. The unit uses provisional country code 402 and awaits coordinator review and the pending official-baseline gate.
required_followup: Coordinator to review sources and exclusions separately and resolve the baseline gate before any official integration.

description: The first web.run open attempt for A Nação CV2102-S002 returned Cache miss after stable receipt CV2102-S002-check1. No contemporaneous manual publisher/origin review record tied to that failed attempt was found in the dossier; the later HTTP fallback has a separate stable check2 and documented full manual review. The Cache miss supplied no body evidence.
required_followup: Retain the failed attempt as a technical fetch failure and do not claim check1 alone authorized it. The later fallback is separately documented; no retry is needed for this limitation.
